pages.description: A sweet anime line art illustration highlights a chibi Hinata sitting on the ground in a cozy cat onesie with pointy ears, whiskers, a long tail, and paw prints on her soles. She wears a mini Leaf Village emblem around her neck while raising her hands like playful kitten paws with a cheerful expression and blunt bangs. Fill this cute design using soft colored pencils, fine-liners, or digital art apps like Procreate on iPad.
